mnemonic.meaning: "OH, YO, SO (およそ)... about a hundred?" Roughly, approximately. You're just guessing.

examples.ja: 駅まで歩いておよそ十分かかる。
examples.en: It takes about ten minutes to walk to the station.

items.note: Formal; だいたい / 約 are close. With a negative it means "not at all": およそ関係ない.

mnemonic.meaning: One (一) kind (種) of seed from the pile. A kind, a sort.
mnemonic.reading: EAT SHOE (いっしゅ)? It's a kind of food, sort of.

examples.ja: これは一種の病気だ。
examples.en: This is a kind of illness.

items.note: 一種の〜 = a sort of.

mnemonic.meaning: The wind (風) blowing over beautiful scenery (景). A landscape, a view.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, CAKE (ふうけい): you eat cake on the hill and admire the scenery.

examples.ja: 窓から美しい風景が見える。
examples.en: You can see beautiful scenery from the window.

items.note: Also a scene from everyday life: 町の風景. 景色 (けしき) is very similar.

mnemonic.meaning: You pile up (積) effort to the extreme (極), on target (的). Active, proactive.
mnemonic.reading: SECK, KYOKU, TEKI (せっきょくてき): she's so proactive she sets a CAKE, YO, COOL TECH-y alarm at 5 a.m.

examples.ja: 彼は何にでも積極的に参加する。
examples.en: He actively takes part in everything.

items.note: Opposite: 消極的 (しょうきょくてき, passive).

mnemonic.meaning: Bright (明) and firm (確). Clear, precise, definite.
mnemonic.reading: MAY CACKLE (めいかく): May's cackle is clear and unmistakable.

examples.ja: 目標を明確にしよう。
examples.en: Let's make our goals clear.

items.note: Formal. はっきり is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Your rank (位) on the ground (地). Your position, status.
mnemonic.reading: CHEE (ちい)ky monkey climbs to the top position.

examples.ja: 彼は会社で高い地位にある。
examples.en: He holds a high position in the company.

items.note: Social position, not a physical place.

mnemonic.meaning: The face (面) you express (表) to the world. The surface, the outside.
mnemonic.reading: HYO, MEN (ひょうめん): "Hyo!" the men skate on the surface of the frozen lake.

examples.ja: 月の表面には穴がたくさんある。
examples.en: There are many craters on the moon's surface.

items.note: Figurative too: 表面上 = on the surface, outwardly.

mnemonic.meaning: 始 is begin: the moment it starts. The beginning.
mnemonic.reading: HA, GEE, MARRY (はじまり): "Ha, gee, let's marry!" The beginning of everything.

examples.ja: それが二人の恋の始まりだった。
examples.en: That was the beginning of their romance.

items.note: Noun from 始まる. 始め is also "beginning".

mnemonic.meaning: The direction (方) of the land (地) out in the country. A region, the provinces.
mnemonic.reading: CHEE, HO (ちほう)! Cheese ho! The cheese comes from the provinces.

examples.ja: 地方の小さな町で育った。
examples.en: I grew up in a small town in the countryside.

items.note: Often "outside the big cities". 関東地方 = the Kanto region.

mnemonic.meaning: OO, CARRY (うっかり): you carelessly carry the wrong bag. Oops, by mistake.

examples.ja: うっかり傘を電車に忘れた。
examples.en: I carelessly left my umbrella on the train.

items.note: Mistakes from not paying attention. わざと is the opposite (on purpose).

mnemonic.meaning: The nature (性) and quality (質) of something. Its character, property.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, SHE TSU (せいしつ): "Say, she's a nice person by nature."

examples.ja: この金属は熱に強い性質がある。
examples.en: This metal has the property of withstanding heat.

items.note: Used for people's temperament and for properties of things. 性格 is just personality.

mnemonic.meaning: 分 is divide: the road divides in two. To split, to branch off.
mnemonic.reading: WACK-A-RAY-RUE (わかれる): you whack the ray and it splits in two.

examples.ja: 道が二つに分かれている。
examples.en: The road splits in two.

items.note: 別れる (also わかれる) = to part from a person. 意見が分かれる = opinions differ.

mnemonic.meaning: Go out (出) and meet (会). An encounter, a meeting.
mnemonic.reading: DAY, EYE (であい): one day your eyes meet. An encounter.

examples.ja: 二人の出会いは大学だった。
examples.en: The two of them met at university.

items.note: Often a meaningful first meeting. 出会い系 = dating sites.

mnemonic.meaning: 案 has 木 (tree) under 安 (peace): you sit peacefully under a tree and come up with a plan.
mnemonic.reading: AHN (あん)... you have an idea! A plan.

examples.ja: いい案が浮かんだ。
examples.en: A good idea came to mind.

items.note: 案外 (unexpectedly), 提案 (proposal), 案内 (guidance).

mnemonic.meaning: The present (現) becomes reality (実). A dream coming true, realization.
mnemonic.reading: GEE TSU, GEN (じつげん)! "Gee, it's GENuinely come true!"

examples.ja: ついに夢が実現した。
examples.en: My dream finally came true.

items.note: 夢を実現する = make a dream come true.

mnemonic.meaning: 経 is pass through: time passes through. To go through.
mnemonic.reading: HAY, RUE (へる): years pass by, and you rue the hay fever every spring.

examples.ja: 長い年月を経て、二人は再会した。
examples.en: After many long years, the two met again.

items.note: Formal and written. 経て = through, via. 減る (へる) means to decrease.

mnemonic.meaning: Take (取り) it up (上げる). To pick up a topic, or to take it away.
mnemonic.reading: TORI AGE-RU (とりあげる): the teacher takes away your fried chicken (鳥揚げ).

examples.ja: ニュースでその問題が取り上げられた。
examples.en: That issue was covered on the news.

items.note: 3 senses: pick up an object; feature a topic; confiscate.

mnemonic.meaning: Heavy (重) and big (大). Serious, grave.
mnemonic.reading: JEW DIE (じゅうだい)? It's serious: someone almost died.

examples.ja: これは重大な問題だ。
examples.en: This is a serious problem.

items.note: Stronger than 大切. Often bad news: 重大な事故.

mnemonic.meaning: Untie (解) and explain (釈) the meaning. Interpretation.
mnemonic.reading: KAI, SHAKU (かいしゃく): Kai shakes his head at your interpretation of the poem.

examples.ja: この文にはいろいろな解釈がある。
examples.en: This sentence can be interpreted in many ways.

items.note: How you read the meaning, not translation (翻訳).

mnemonic.meaning: Challenge (挑) someone to a fight (戦). A challenge, an attempt.
mnemonic.reading: CHO, SEN (ちょうせん): "Yo, SEN-sei, I challenge you!"

examples.ja: 新しいことに挑戦したい。
examples.en: I want to try something new.

items.note: Positive: taking on a challenge. Not "difficulty" (that's 課題 or 難しさ).

mnemonic.meaning: 高 is high: it gets higher by itself. To rise, to increase.
mnemonic.reading: TACO, MARU (たかまる): taco prices rise and rise.

examples.ja: 試合が近づき、緊張が高まってきた。
examples.en: As the match approached, the tension rose.

items.note: Intransitive (it rises). The partner 高める means you raise it.

mnemonic.meaning: 高 is high: you make it higher. To raise, to improve.
mnemonic.reading: TACO, MEh-RUE (たかめる): you improve the taco recipe and raise its price.

examples.ja: 練習して技術を高めたい。
examples.en: I want to improve my skills with practice.

items.note: Transitive (you raise it). 高まる is the intransitive partner.

mnemonic.meaning: Divide (分) and split (析) it up. Analysis.
mnemonic.reading: BUN, SECKY (ぶんせき): you split the bun and analyse the secret sauce.

examples.ja: データを分析した結果、問題が分かった。
examples.en: Analysing the data revealed the problem.

items.note: Formal and academic.

mnemonic.meaning: The horizon (涯) of your life (生). Your lifetime.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW GUY (しょうがい): the show guy performs his whole life.

examples.ja: 彼は生涯を研究に捧げた。
examples.en: He devoted his whole life to research.

items.note: Formal. 一生 is everyday. 生涯学習 = lifelong learning.

mnemonic.meaning: Together (共) they pass (通) through the same thing. Common, shared.
mnemonic.reading: KYO, TSUU (きょうつう): Kyoto and Tsu have something in common.

examples.ja: 二人には共通の趣味がある。
examples.en: The two of them share a hobby.

items.note: 共通点 = something in common. 共通語 = a common language.

mnemonic.meaning: Control (制) and limit (限). A restriction.
mnemonic.reading: SAY GEN (せいげん): "Say, Gen, you've hit your limit."

examples.ja: この道は速度制限が四十キロだ。
examples.en: The speed limit on this road is 40 km/h.

items.note: 年齢制限 = age limit. 時間制限 = time limit.

mnemonic.meaning: Go out (出) outside (外). Going out, an outing.
mnemonic.reading: GUY, SHOE, TSU (がいしゅつ): the guy puts on his shoes and goes out.

examples.ja: 今日は雨なので外出しなかった。
examples.en: It was raining today, so I didn't go out.

items.note: A bit formal; 出かける is everyday. 外出中 = out of the office.

mnemonic.meaning: MATO, MARU (まとまる): the mat is rolled into a neat circle (まる). Everything comes together, settled and organized.

examples.ja: やっと話がまとまった。
examples.en: We finally reached an agreement.

items.note: Intransitive partner of まとめる (Level 3). まとまったお金 = a decent sum of money.

mnemonic.meaning: Pass through (経) and run (営) the business. Management.
mnemonic.reading: CAY, A (けいえい): she runs a small business on a Caribbean cay. Management!

examples.ja: 父は小さな店を経営している。
examples.en: My father runs a small shop.

items.note: For running businesses. 管理 (かんり) is managing things or people.

mnemonic.meaning: 働 is work: the work something does. Its function, activity.
mnemonic.reading: HATTA, RAKI (はたらき): the hatter works hard, raking in money.

examples.ja: 肝臓の働きについて学んだ。
examples.en: We learned about how the liver works.

items.note: Also "efforts": 彼の働きで成功した (we succeeded thanks to his work).
